title: Author 3-4 more general sets across >=3 journey stages
context: M0 proves the pipeline with one pilot set (qpl-set-001). M1 builds repeatability by authoring 3-4 additional general-purpose QPL sets spanning at least 3 distinct journey stages. These sets deepen the coverage matrix, generate enough throughput to stress-test the review pipeline and rotation, and demonstrate that the quality bar is reproducible. Each set follows exactly the same authoring and dual sign-off process as the pilot. High-impact, high-uncertainty stages not covered by the pilot (treatment-decision, clinical-trials, managing-side-effects) are prioritized. All sets remain general (not cancer-type-specific, which comes in M3). None are shipped until dual-signed-off and CI-green.
objective: Author 3 to 4 additional original QPL sets covering at least 3 distinct journey stages from the taxonomy (e.g., treatment-decision, managing-side-effects, clinical-trials, survivorship), each following the full M0 pipeline: style guide, allow-listed sources, provenance, UNCERTAIN: flags resolved, disclaimer, verified support resources, dual expert sign-off, readability/a11y checks, and CI-green.
acceptanceCriteria: Between 3 and 4 new general QPL set files are present in sets/<stage>/general/set.yaml, each validating against qplSetSchema
Sets collectively cover at least 3 distinct journey stages from taxonomy/journey-stages.yaml, none of which is newly-diagnosed (already covered by qpl-set-001)
Each set is original (original-authorship attestation present, no copyrighted QPL copied), grounded in allow-listed sources, with provenance on all framing claims
Each set contains the verbatim disclaimer and verified support resources from support/resources.yaml

Each set has been independently dual-signed-off: one credentialed oncology clinician + one trained patient advocate, with COI declarations, recorded in the review block and PR; all UNCERTAIN: flags resolved before sign-off
Any set touching end-of-life, prognosis, fertility, or genetics has the topic-appropriate credentialed reviewer (palliative-care, genetic counsellor) — not just a general oncologist
All sets pass CI structural checks (qpl-schema-001/qpl-license-001), readability/accessibility checks (qpl-a11y-001), and license/provenance enforcement (qpl-license-001)
Coverage matrix in the repo is updated to reflect the new cells
output: 3-4 new sets/<stage>/general/set.yaml files, each with dual sign-off block; updated coverage matrix
